notes.title: Welcome to Northvale — your accounts are fully invested
notes.body:
Your $5,000,000 is invested across a Rollover IRA and an Individual Brokerage account in a conservative growth mix: about 69% stocks, mostly broad index funds, with bonds, Treasury bills, gold and real estate for stability.

We start during a choppy stretch. U.S. stocks have pulled back from their October highs, led by large technology names. That doesn't change the plan. We don't chase headlines; we review every Monday and only act when the mix drifts or something real changes.

Expect most weeks to be quiet. That's by design.
